belief: I can't learn or grow anymore.
origins: After injury or with age, we may stop trying new things because of earlier failures. The brain, however, retains the ability to adapt, and spiritual growth does not depend on speed or memory.
teaches: “Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.” “He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.” “Be transformed by the renewing of your mind.” Spiritual growth in love, patience, and trust does not depend on IQ or memory. And the brain can often form new pathways with practice and rehabilitation. Growth may be slower, but it is real.
self_statements: I am stuck where I am.
errors: Believing growth is either fast or impossible.
Feeling stuck and concluding I cannot grow.
questions: What have I learned or recovered since the injury?
What small goal could I try?
What therapists or programs could help?
How have I grown spiritually through this?
What does Scripture promise about God’s work in me?
truth: Growth continues, though at a different pace. My inner self is renewed daily, and God will complete His work in me. I can learn in small steps.
hw_truths: My inner self is renewed daily.
log: Each week, note one thing you learned or improved.
prayer: Lord, I feel stuck. Renew my mind, give me patience for small steps, and finish the work You began in me. Amen.
